ucs.title: [LLM] Akira pre-encryption recovery sabotage — WMI/vssadmin shadow-copy wipe before .akira drop
ucs.description: Hunts Akira's (GOLD SAHARA / PUNK SPIDER / Howling Scorpius) documented anti-recovery finale: the operator deletes Volume Shadow Copies via PowerShell `Get-WmiObject Win32_Shadowcopy | Remove-WmiObject` (and vssadmin/wmic variants) seconds before the Akira/Megazord encryptor runs. This exact WMI one-liner is a hallmark of Akira intrusions and is far more specific than generic vssadmin deletion.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name IN ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","wmic.exe","vssadmin.exe")) by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_name Processes.process
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| eval p=lower(process)
| where (match(p,"win32_shadowcopy") AND (match(p,"remove-wmiobject") OR match(p,"\.delete\(\)") OR match(p,"delete"))) OR (match(p,"vssadmin") AND match(p,"delete") AND match(p,"shadows")) OR (match(p,"wmic") AND match(p,"shadowcopy") AND match(p,"delete"))
| where NOT match(user,"\$$")
| convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime)
| table firstTime lastTime dest user parent_process_name process_name process count
| sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where FileName in~ ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","wmic.exe","vssadmin.exe")
| where (ProcessCommandLine has "Win32_Shadowcopy" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("Remove-WmiObject",".Delete()","delete"))
      or (ProcessCommandLine has "vssadmin" and ProcessCommandLine has "delete" and ProcessCommandLine has "shadows")
      or (ProcessCommandLine has_all ("wmic","shadowcopy","delete"))
| where AccountName !endswith "$"               // exclude machine accounts
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName,
          InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ProcessCommandLine, SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where EventID == 4688
| where NewProcessName has_any ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","wmic.exe","vssadmin.exe")
| where (CommandLine has "Win32_Shadowcopy" and CommandLine has_any ("Remove-WmiObject",".Delete()","delete"))
      or (CommandLine has "vssadmin" and CommandLine has "delete" and CommandLine has "shadows")
      or (CommandLine has_all ("wmic","shadowcopy","delete"))
| where not(SubjectUserName endswith "$")
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, NewProcessName, ParentProcessName, CommandLine
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Akira Ransomware Shadow Copy Deletion via WMI/VSSAdmin
id: 8f2c4a91-3b7e-4c2d-9a1f-akira0recovery1
status: experimental
description: Detects Akira ransomware operators deleting Volume Shadow Copies prior to encryption, including the characteristic Get-WmiObject Win32_Shadowcopy | Remove-WmiObject one-liner.
references:
  - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa24-109a
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_img:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
      - '\cmd.exe'
      - '\wmic.exe'
      - '\vssadmin.exe'
  sel_wmi:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - 'Win32_Shadowcopy'
  sel_wmi_verb:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'Remove-WmiObject'
      - '.Delete()'
      - 'delete'
  sel_vss:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - 'delete'
      - 'shadows'
  sel_wmic:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - 'shadowcopy'
      - 'delete'
  condition: selection_img and ( (sel_wmi and sel_wmi_verb) or sel_vss or sel_wmic )
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate backup software pruning shadow copies
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @Image:(*\powershell.exe OR *\PowerShell.exe OR *\POWERSHELL.EXE OR *\pwsh.exe OR *\cmd.exe OR *\CMD.EXE OR *\wmic.exe OR *\WMIC.EXE OR *\vssadmin.exe OR *\VSSAdmin.exe) AND ((@CommandLine:(*Win32_Shadowcopy* OR *win32_shadowcopy*) AND @CommandLine:(*Remove-WmiObject* OR *Delete()* OR *delete*)) OR (@CommandLine:(*shadows* OR *Shadows*) AND @CommandLine:(*delete* OR *Delete*)))
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ImageFileName=/\\(powershell|pwsh|cmd|wmic|vssadmin)\.exe$/i
| regex("(?i)(win32_shadowcopy.*(remove-wmiobject|\\.delete\\(\\)|delete)|vssadmin.*delete.*shadows|wmic.*shadowcopy.*delete)", field=CommandLine)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ImageFileName, CommandLine], function=count())

ucs.title: [LLM] Akira hands-on-keyboard staging cluster — exfil + network discovery + remote-access tooling on one host
ucs.description: Hunts the multi-tool footprint Akira leaves on a beachhead before encryption: bulk exfil utilities (rclone/WinSCP/FileZilla to MEGA/cloud), LAN discovery scanners (Advanced IP Scanner, SoftPerfect netscan, masscan) and operator remote-access/tunnels (AnyDesk, RustDesk, Ngrok, Cloudflared). Co-occurrence of ≥2 of these tool categories on a single host within the window is a strong Akira intrusion signal, not normal admin activity.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name IN ("rclone.exe","winscp.exe","filezilla.exe","anydesk.exe","rustdesk.exe","advanced_ip_scanner.exe","netscan.exe","masscan.exe","ngrok.exe","cloudflared.exe")) by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.process
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| eval category=case(process_name IN ("rclone.exe","winscp.exe","filezilla.exe"),"Exfil", process_name IN ("advanced_ip_scanner.exe","netscan.exe","masscan.exe"),"Discovery", process_name IN ("anydesk.exe","rustdesk.exe","ngrok.exe","cloudflared.exe"),"RemoteAccess", 1=1,"Other")
| where NOT match(user,"\$$")
| stats dc(category) as categories values(category) as categories_seen values(process_name) as tools values(process) as cmds min(firstTime) as firstTime max(lastTime) as lastTime by dest
| where categories>=2
| convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime)
| sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
let Lookback = 7d;
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
| where FileName in~ ("rclone.exe","winscp.exe","filezilla.exe","anydesk.exe","rustdesk.exe","advanced_ip_scanner.exe","netscan.exe","masscan.exe","ngrok.exe","cloudflared.exe")
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| extend Category = case(
    FileName in~ ("rclone.exe","winscp.exe","filezilla.exe"), "Exfil",
    FileName in~ ("advanced_ip_scanner.exe","netscan.exe","masscan.exe"), "Discovery",
    FileName in~ ("anydesk.exe","rustdesk.exe","ngrok.exe","cloudflared.exe"), "RemoteAccess",
    "Other")
| summarize Categories = dcount(Category), CategorySet = make_set(Category),
            Tools = make_set(FileName), Cmds = make_set(ProcessCommandLine, 12),
            FirstSeen = min(Timestamp), LastSeen = max(Timestamp)
          by DeviceName, AccountName
| where Categories >= 2     // >=2 distinct Akira staging categories on one host = high signal
| order by LastSeen desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let Lookback = 7d;
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
| where EventID == 4688
| extend Img = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
| where Img in ("rclone.exe","winscp.exe","filezilla.exe","anydesk.exe","rustdesk.exe","advanced_ip_scanner.exe","netscan.exe","masscan.exe","ngrok.exe","cloudflared.exe")
| where not(SubjectUserName endswith "$")
| extend Category = case(
    Img in ("rclone.exe","winscp.exe","filezilla.exe"), "Exfil",
    Img in ("advanced_ip_scanner.exe","netscan.exe","masscan.exe"), "Discovery",
    Img in ("anydesk.exe","rustdesk.exe","ngrok.exe","cloudflared.exe"), "RemoteAccess",
    "Other")
| summarize Categories = dcount(Category), CategorySet = make_set(Category),
            Tools = make_set(Img), Cmds = make_set(CommandLine, 12),
            FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated)
          by Computer, SubjectUserName
| where Categories >= 2
| order by LastSeen desc
